name: openclaw
title: OpenClaw
description: Monitor and chat with your OpenClaw Gateway from Raycast
author: leveragedrobot

commands.name: control-center
commands.title: OpenClaw Control Center
commands.description: Monitor Gateway health, tasks, sessions, agents, nodes, channels, and usage

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask OpenClaw
commands.description: Ask OpenClaw a question in a new Gateway session

commands.name: chat
commands.title: Chat with OpenClaw
commands.description: Start or continue an OpenClaw Gateway conversation

commands.name: clipboard
commands.title: Ask About Clipboard
commands.description: Send clipboard text to OpenClaw with your question

commands.name: selected-text
commands.title: Process Selected Text
commands.description: Summarize, explain, translate, or rewrite selected text

commands.name: status
commands.title: Gateway Status
commands.description: Check the authenticated OpenClaw Gateway connection

commands.name: open-webchat
commands.title: Open OpenClaw Control UI
commands.description: Open the configured Gateway Control UI in your browser

preferences.name: connectionMode
preferences.title: How Should Raycast Connect?
preferences.description: Choose where the OpenClaw Gateway runs and how Raycast reaches it.

preferences.name: endpoint
preferences.title: Gateway URL
preferences.description: Required for Local Network, Tailscale, and Cloudflare. Every remote connection must use wss://.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Gateway Token
preferences.description: Optional shared Gateway token. Leave empty to use a paired device token or read a string token from ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json.

preferences.name: password
preferences.title: Gateway Password
preferences.description: Optional Gateway password. A token is preferred when both are available.

preferences.name: agentId
preferences.title: Agent ID
preferences.description: The default OpenClaw agent for new conversations.

preferences.name: cloudflareAuthMode
preferences.title: Cloudflare Access Method
preferences.description: Used only for Cloudflare. Browser sign-in opens the identity provider configured by the Access policy, such as GitHub or Google.

data.title: Browser Sign-In (GitHub, Google, or Other IdP)

preferences.name: cloudflareAccessClientId
preferences.title: Cloudflare Access Client ID
preferences.description: Required only when Cloudflare authentication is set to Service Token.

preferences.name: cloudflareAccessClientSecret
preferences.title: Cloudflare Access Client Secret
preferences.description: Required only when Cloudflare authentication is set to Service Token.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:bundle
scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
